g.text: Five-character concept lineup, 1930s coastal-noir style, muted teal-
teal #6fb8af, rust-red #c95d43 accents). Characters left to right:
retired navy captain in weathered trench coat with peaked cap
holding a revolver; hooded folklore scholar with a rune staff;
bounty hunter with wide-brim hat and sawed-off shotgun on back;
field physician in short cape carrying a medical case; blasting
engineer with welding mask pushed up and nail-gun on hip. Full-body
silhouettes plus 3/4-view color versions, single row, fog beach
backdrop, low pale moon. Painterly, grain texture, no text.
Full prompt: Eagle annotation and request.md
